name: Maneuver detection
description: Detects maneuvers in an element-set history. Takes each element set's trajectory from any propagator, finds where consecutive trajectories cross, measures the energy and orbit-plane change there, and flags steps beyond the object's own noise. Emits $MNV DETECTED events with time, in-track and cross-track delta-V, pre and post states and characterization. Element sets may be given instead of ephemerides; the module then propagates them with Vallado SGP4.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic statistics over caller-supplied inertial ephemerides. No host calls, threads, propagation or network access.

inputPorts.description: One or more $OEM frames (or element sets on elements). One data block per element set, in an Earth-centred inertial frame, spanning at least the neighbouring element sets' epochs (two on each side recommended). Blocks are grouped by OBJECT and ordered by the midpoint of their span.

wildcardJustification.detail: {objects: [{id?, norad?, name?, sets: [{mjd (UTC), MEAN_MOTION, ECCENTRICITY, INCLINATION, RA_OF_ASC_NODE, ARG_OF_PERICENTER, MEAN_ANOMALY, BSTAR, comment?}]}]}: SGP4 element sets the module propagates itself (Vallado SGP4, WGS-72) into one TEME block per set over its neighbours' epochs (two on each side) on the grid_step_s grid.

inputPorts.description: Element-set histories as JSON, propagated by the module with SGP4 instead of caller-supplied ephemerides.

wildcardJustification.detail: Detection thresholds as a JSON object (k, floor_in_track_mps, floor_cross_track_mps, median_sets, scale_window_pairs, grid_step_s, report_time); every field optional.

inputPorts.description: Detection thresholds as a JSON object; every field optional.

outputPorts.description: One $MNV frame per detected maneuver, STATUS DETECTED.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-pair crossing times, jumps, steps and thresholds for every object, and each event's evidence; the scientific result is the $MNV frames.

outputPorts.description: Per-pair crossing times, jumps, steps and thresholds, and each event's evidence, as JSON.
